signals.topic: Windows: sass-loader fails to resolve SCSS imports from node_modules breaking npm run dev
signals.summary: Next.js bundled sass-loader defaults to legacy API with webpackImporter:true, which loses path context on Windows when resolving SCSS imports inside node_modules. Running npm run dev fails immediately on Windows native (no WSL).
signals.review_reason: Main development workflow is completely blocked on Windows: npm run dev fails immediately with 'Can't find stylesheet to import' when SCSS files in node_modules use relative imports. This contradicts Next.js's own documentation stating 'This site can be developed on Windows'. No framework-level workaround available; requires patching bundled sass-loader code.

signals.topic: Turbopack dev server fails with pnpm v11 enableGlobalVirtualStore due to symlink resolution
signals.summary: When pnpm v11's enableGlobalVirtualStore is enabled, node_modules/next is a symlink pointing outside the project root, causing Turbopack to fail resolving next/package.json with 'Couldn't find the Next.js package'. Webpack dev mode works fine as workaround.
signals.review_reason: Dev server startup is completely blocked when using the recommended package manager configuration (pnpm v11 with enableGlobalVirtualStore:true). Users must either fall back to webpack dev mode or disable the global virtual store feature. The workaround is not practical for teams relying on pnpm v11 defaults.

signals.topic: App Router dev mode: browser Back after notFound() leaves previous page silently detached/uninteractive

signals.review_reason: Standard browser navigation (Back button) after a notFound() page permanently breaks the previous page's interactivity with no automatic recovery. signals.topic: Latest SDK version not published to npm registry

signals.topic: turbo prune --docker 生成无效 Bun lockfile 导致 Docker 构建失败
signals.summary: 运行 `turbo prune @pkg --docker` 时，生成的 out/json/bun.lock 包含不完整的嵌套 npm 包条目（保留了依赖方但删除了被依赖的嵌套包），导致 `bun install --frozen-lockfile` 失败，Docker 镜像构建完全阻断。
aliases: bun install frozen-lockfile fails after prune
signals.review_reason: 虽然 count=1，但有完整复现步骤、直接阻断 Docker 构建核心工作流。用户提供了可验证的 Dockerfile 和 repo，影响明确：CI/CD pipeline 完全失败，Docker 镜像无法构建。根据 review_reason 给出强用户影响证据，标记 P0 合理。

source_issues.title: Turbo prune emits invalid Bun lockfile for pruned workspace with nested npm package entries
source_issues.evidence: 用户使用 turbo prune --docker 后生成的 bun.lock 保留 npm/@npmcli/arborist 但删除了其依赖 @npmcli/metavuln-calculator，导致 bun install --frozen-lockfile 报错 'Failed to resolve prod dependency'，Docker 构建失败。提供了完整可复现的仓库和 Dockerfile。

signals.topic: Windows 原生环境下 Turbo 安装失败（找不到二进制文件）
signals.summary: 在 Windows 11 原生环境（非 WSL）中通过 npm 安装 turbo 后，运行 turbo build 等命令时报错找不到正确的 Windows 二进制文件（turbo-windows-64/bin/turbo.exe），即使相同 Node/npm 版本在 WSL2 中完全正常。这导致 Windows 用户无法使用 Turbo，是平台级阻断问题。
signals.review_reason: Windows 是 Turbo 的核心支持平台，安装失败等同于核心功能不可用。有 13 条评论且 issue 开放 9 个月未解决，说明持续影响大量 Windows 用户。与 WSL 对比证明是 Windows 安装脚本/binary 发布流程问题，不是用户环境问题。单仓 count=1 但强用户影响证据支撑 P0。

source_issues.title: Turborepo Installation Fails on Windows - Missing Binaries
source_issues.evidence: 用户在 Windows 11 (build 26100) 上安装 turbo 后报错 'Turborepo did not find the correct binary for your platform (windows 64)'，npm 日志显示 turbo-windows-64 和 turbo-windows-arm64 均未正确安装。相同配置在 WSL2 下完全正常。Issue 持续活跃（有 13 条评论），issue 开放超过 9 个月未解决。

signals.topic: CLI `vercel env add --value` silently stores empty string, breaking production secrets and CI/CD env var scripts
signals.summary: CLI 53.x regressed `vercel env add --value` to silently write empty strings instead of actual values, and `--sensitive` flag has been broken since CLI 50.5.0. The CLI reports success but the actual stored value is empty, causing production failures when secrets are missing at runtime.
signals.review_reason: Production-critical: two regressions (plain --value since 53.x, --sensitive since 50.5.0) silently write empty strings for environment variables. CLI reports success while storing empty values. Production applications read empty secrets, causing HMAC failures, broken API authentication, and silent data loss. Impact is widespread as CLI 53.x is the current npm 'latest' default. Evidence includes explicit repro steps and cross-version testing matrix.

source_issues.title: vercel env add: --value silently stored as empty string (CLI 53.x), and --sensitive empty since 50.5.0
source_issues.evidence: Bug 1 (CLI 53.x): vercel@53.2.0 env add --value <64-hex> silently stores empty string; env pull returns NAME="". Bug 2 (CLI 50.5.0-53.2.0): --sensitive flag also stores empty. CLI prints success message but actual value is empty. This silently breaks production secrets, HMAC keys, and API keys at runtime.

signals.topic: CLI `pnpm dlx vercel@53.x` install fails due to unpublished `@vercel/elysia@0.1.74` dependency, blocking CI/CD pipelines
signals.summary: vercel@53.3.0 (and 53.3.0) declares a dependency on @vercel/elysia@0.1.74 which has never been published to npm. This causes pnpm dlx and other install methods to fail with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION, blocking CI jobs that dynamically install the Vercel CLI.
aliases: CLI package not published to npm
signals.review_reason: Main流程阻断: CI/CD pipelines that use pnpm dlx to install the Vercel CLI fail immediately. GitHub Actions workflows are blocked. The issue is confirmed with exact error message and the unpublished package version. Since CLI 53.x is the latest release, this affects all new CI setups.

source_issues.title: vercel@53.3.0 depends on unpublished @vercel/elysia@0.1.74
source_issues.evidence: pnpm dlx vercel@53.3.0 fails with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION for @vercel/elysia@0.1.74. Latest npm release of @vercel/elysia is 0.1.73. This blocks CI jobs in GitHub Actions and any automation that dynamically installs the CLI.

signals.topic: @vercel/react-router skew protection not applied to nodejs runtime routes, causing 404s on stale cached HTML after deploys
signals.summary: @vercel/react-router vite plugin only injects skew protection entry.server (setting __vdpl cookie) for edge runtime, not for default nodejs runtime. Users with skew protection enabled in dashboard still get 404s on content-hashed assets after every deploy because the nodejs entry.server falls back to React Router's default which has no skew protection.
aliases: React Router nodejs runtime no __vdpl cookie
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用: Skew protection is explicitly enabled in the Vercel dashboard but completely non-functional for nodejs runtime (the default). Users experience 404s on their deployed apps after every deploy due to stale cached assets. This is a feature mismatch between dashboard UI and actual behavior — users believe protection is active when it is not.

source_issues.title: @vercel/react-router: Skew Protection entry.server only injected for edge runtime, not nodejs
source_issues.evidence: Skew protection __vdpl cookie is only injected for edge runtime routes. Nodejs runtime routes fall back to React Router's built-in entry.server.node.tsx with no skew protection, causing Cache-Control: public with no max-age. After deploy, clients with cached HTML get 404s for old content-hashed asset chunks. Dashboard shows skew protection enabled but it is effectively disabled for nodejs routes.

signals.topic: Vercel Security Checkpoint produces false positives with no user-facing mechanism to report or resolve them
signals.summary: Legitimate visitors to Vercel-protected sites receive 'Failed to verify your browser Code 11 Vercel Security Checkpoint' errors with no way to report false positives. The error page does not link to a contact channel, and the only apparent contact option is a sales form. Legitimate users are blocked from accessing content with no recourse.
aliases: security checkpoint false positive no recourse
blocked by Vercel security no contact option
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降: Legitimate users are blocked from accessing content with no user-facing mechanism to report false positives. This is not a one-off edge case — security checkpoints inherently produce false positives, and without a reporting path, these users have no recourse. However, count=1 and only affects external visitors to protected sites (not developers), so P2.

source_issues.title: False positive 'Failed to verify your browser Code 11 Vercel Security Checkpoint'
source_issues.evidence: A legitimate user visiting docs.arbitrum.io received the Vercel Security Checkpoint error (Code 11) and found no way to report the false positive. The error page provides no contact link. Only vercel.com/contact/sales is available, which is not appropriate for security false positive reporting. Visitor was blocked from accessing the site.

signals.topic: CLI `vercel logs` hangs indefinitely with no historical log access, making debugging impractical and breaking AI tool integrations
signals.summary: The `vercel logs` command only shows live logs from now onwards and hangs indefinitely when no new logs are generated. There is no way to view historical logs from the CLI. This breaks developer debugging workflows, is inconsistent with standard CLI patterns (docker logs, kubectl logs), and prevents AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code from accessing deployment logs.
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降: Long-standing CLI usability issue causing the logs command to be practically unusable. Command hangs indefinitely without logs and provides no historical log access. Breaks AI tool integrations (Cursor, Claude Code). While open since October 2025 with recent activity, count=1 and it's a feature gap rather than a hard block, so P2.

source_issues.title: Historical logs in vercel logs command
source_issues.evidence: vercel logs command hangs indefinitely waiting for new logs when no traffic occurs. No option to view historical logs. This breaks expected CLI behavior (docker logs, kubectl logs all show existing logs first). AI tools like Cursor and Claude Code cannot use the CLI for log access. Workaround requires using the web dashboard or direct API calls.

signals.topic: Settings (hover_popover_sticky, recent projects) not respected or fail to persist
signals.summary: Two separate settings-related issues: (1) hover_popover_sticky setting does not cause the popover to close on hover as configured; (2) the Recent Projects list randomly clears, losing all saved projects. Both represent the settings system failing to persist or honor user configuration.
signals.review_reason: Settings system is failing to honor user preferences (hover_popover_sticky) or persist state (recent projects list), both of which degrade the user experience by making Zed's behavior unpredictable and contradicting documented settings.

source_issues.title: Setting "hover_popover_sticky" not working/responding
source_issues.evidence: User sets hover_popover_sticky to false via both settings.json and GUI settings. The popover does not close when hovering over it, contradicting the setting name and the expected behavior. Reproduced on Zed Preview v1.2.2 on Linux Wayland.

source_issues.title: Projects randomly disappearing from the Recent Projects list (Ctrl-Alt-O)
source_issues.evidence: User reports that the Recent Projects list (Ctrl-Alt-O) intermittently loses all previously added projects. The list becomes completely empty, forcing manual re-navigation. The clearing appears to happen randomly, not strictly on restart, and causes loss of workflow context.

signals.topic: Rust external formatter (cargo fmt) clears current file contents on save, causing data loss
signals.summary: When using `cargo fmt --all` as an external formatter, Zed wipes the entire contents of the currently open file, destroying user work. Running cargo fmt from terminal works correctly, isolating the bug to Zed's external formatter integration.
signals.review_reason: Direct data loss — entire file content is erased by a save action. The user provides reproduction steps and a video demonstrating the clearing. This is not a performance issue or cosmetic bug; it is a workflow-blocking data destruction event that makes the external formatter feature dangerous to use.

source_issues.title: Rust external formatter using cargo fmt clears current file contents
source_issues.evidence: Using `cargo fmt --all` as external formatter causes the currently opened Rust file to be completely cleared. The user provides steps to reproduce and a video showing the file content being erased. Running cargo fmt directly from terminal works correctly, confirming the bug is in Zed's integration layer.

signals.topic: Agent streaming edits cause unbounded LSP Edit tab accumulation leading to OOM and process crash
signals.summary: When a sub-agent performs streaming edits on files with active LSP servers, 'LSP Edit' editor tabs accumulate without bound. Each tab holds a full MultiBuffer with diff data, causing memory to grow until the process runs out of memory and crashes.
signals.review_reason: Process OOM crash caused by unbounded memory growth during normal agent feature usage. The root cause is precisely identified in Zed's own code (editor.rs). This makes the agent feature actively dangerous in projects with active LSP servers, as it will inevitably crash the editor.

source_issues.title: Multiple "LSP Edit" tabs accumulate during agent streaming edits, causing OOM
source_issues.evidence: User describes memory growing until OOM during agent streaming edits. Root cause is identified in code at `crates/editor/src/editor.rs#L7187-7212` where `open_transaction_for_hidden_buffers` creates new editor tabs per buffer change without bound. Character-level streaming edits trigger a cascade of LSP workspace/applyEdit responses.

signals.topic: Format on save setting is ignored on Linux — formatting runs on every manual save even when disabled, causing 3-4s delay
signals.summary: On Linux, format on save continues to trigger even when disabled. Every manual file save takes 3-4 seconds regardless of the setting, with `[editor] timed out waiting for formatting` logged on every save. This directly contradicts the documented setting and causes measurable productivity loss.
aliases: format on save not respected Linux
signals.review_reason: Settings system bug where a user-configured option is silently ignored, causing a consistent 3-4 second delay on every manual save. The user provides log evidence (`timed out waiting for formatting`) proving the formatter fires regardless of the setting. This degrades the core file save workflow on Linux.

source_issues.title: Format on save option when disabled is not respected on Linux
source_issues.evidence: User reports saves take 3-4 seconds regardless of format-on-save setting (on or off). Log shows `timed out waiting for formatting` on every save, confirming formatting runs despite being disabled. User is on Arch Linux. Explicitly violates the documented editor behavior.

signals.topic: Zed editor window does not display on xrdp (remote desktop) — only taskbar icon appears
signals.summary: On Debian xrdp remote desktop connections, the Zed editor window does not render. The process shows up in the taskbar but no editor window is displayed. This completely blocks the use of Zed in remote desktop environments.
signals.review_reason: Editor is completely unusable in xrdp remote desktop sessions. The window never renders, blocking the primary editing workflow. This affects a legitimate use case (remote development) and renders the entire application non-functional in that environment.

source_issues.title: debian xrdp shows up on taskbar but no editor window is displayed
source_issues.evidence: User on Debian 12 xrdp connection reports that `/usr/libexec/zed-editor` shows only in the taskbar with no visible window. The system has no GPU (lspci returns nothing) and uses software rendering via Vulkan. The editor is completely unusable in this remote desktop configuration.
